items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta, full launch, and rights-dependent monetization; conditional for ordinary reversible growth preserving existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and data boundaries. Evidence: Woot documentation establishes API access but not public display, storage, derivatives, caching, alerts, affiliate, advertising, image, price, or trademark rights; public terms restrict product-data collection and derivative use. Human counsel is required before any permission request or rights-dependent launch decision. Exact decision: keep SearchWoot private and keep outreach unsent.

Fleet compliance disposition: conditional for ordinary reversible growth, not fleet-wide clearance. Technical baseline reports 36 pass, 17 fail, and 6 unknown, with open banner, consent, GA4, privacy, and terms findings. Incomplete telemetry is not itself a blocker, but unreachable or failed sites require concrete site decisions before launch or monetization. Retain complicated.work and deadlymaracas.com parked/private pending readiness evidence; do not treat broadwayshowgirls.com or deeppenetrations.com as cleared while latest compliance checks are unreachable.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 open. Progress is evidenced by official Woot documentation, public terms/support records, repository and configuration artifacts, privacy and cookie-policy artifacts, and draft terms. No task is closable because material rights, retention, deletion, correction, access, notification, GA4, vendor, and incident evidence remains incomplete. Next evidence action: attach and review one consolidated read-only bundle covering the field-level rights matrix, deployed data flow and retention, log/vendor/incident inventory, consent and GA4 configuration, accuracy/freshness, and rollback evidence.

Data-use dispositions: Woot API deal and price-history data is blocked pending current written permission or an API agreement, field-level provenance, permitted storage/caching/display/derivative/alert use, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, image/price/trademark terms, and affiliate/advertising rights. User alert rules and sync results are evidence_needed pending a read-only data inventory, identifiers, retention, deletion/correction/access workflow, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. GA4 analytics is evidence_needed pending deployed consent/withdrawal evidence, GA4 property/data-sharing and retention settings, and jurisdictional review. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data are evidence_needed pending log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor terms or DPA review, and incident/request procedures. Smallest next actions are respectively: complete the internal counsel packet for human-counsel review; produce the data-flow and retention table; capture consent and GA4 configuration evidence without enabling new tracking; produce the log/vendor/incident inventory.

Data-quality and revenue evidence do not support financial claims. Analytics is yellow because at least one GA4/GSC source is unavailable or returning an error; revenue covers 2026-09-21 only, with $4.92 aggregate commission under an unattributed provider row. Do not infer site revenue, ROI, margin, payback, forecasts, or causal lift. Continue existing matching-period reconciliation only.

Security and launch evidence remain insufficient for public exposure: fleet-doctor and operations sweeps have no results, and all 59 security sitefacts remain unknown. Keep security-sensitive public exposure blocked and permit only bounded reversible work within existing boundaries. This is evidence triage, not certification or legal advice.
